evals.prompt: We import aluminium from China, about 500 tonnes per year. Walk me through what we need to do for CBAM.
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step CBAM compliance: confirms in scope, calculation method, certificate estimation, deadlines.
assertions: Confirms aluminium (CN 76) is in CBAM scope
Explains embedded emissions calculation (direct + indirect for aluminium)
Estimates certificate cost based on current EU ETS price
Lists key deadlines (authorized declarant, first surrender)
